entities.name: Mount Tanufel
entities.description: Tallest peak in Lorwyn, sacred mountain and birthplace of the flamekin.

entities.name: Flamekin
entities.description: Elemental race born on Mount Tanufel.

entities.name: Rimekin
entities.description: Race with a settlement in the snowy peaks.

entities.name: Wanderwine River
entities.description: River with headwaters on Mount Tanufel, most merrow-trafficked in Lorwyn.

entities.name: Ember Fell
entities.description: Flamekin monastery in the Mount Tanufel region built of obsidian.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: Flamekin who took the greater elemental's power for herself and became the Extinguisher.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: Greater elemental whose wisdom was to join the flamekin flame.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: Event during which Ashling's ritual took place.

events.summary: During the Great Aurora ritual on Mount Tanufel, Ashling takes the elemental's power for herself and becomes the Extinguisher.
events.quote: Ashling decided to take the greater elemental's power for herself and became the Extinguisher.

relations.quote: Mount Tanufel is the tallest peak in Lorwyn
guarded by an elemental called The Source
